title: Cottage Pie
description: Savory ground beef and vegetables in a rich gravy under a fluffy, golden mashed potato topping. British comfort food at its best.

image.alt: A baking dish of cottage pie with a golden mashed potato top

steps.text: Cover the potatoes with cold salted water, bring to a boil and cook until very tender, {time 15-18 min}. Drain, return to the pot and mash with the butter, warm milk and salt until smooth.
Meanwhile heat the oven to {temp 400F oven}. Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat and brown the beef, breaking it up, {time 6-8 min}. Spoon off excess fat.
Add the onion and carrots and cook until softened, {time 6 min}. Stir in the garlic, flour and tomato paste for {time 1 min}.
Stir in the broth, Worcestershire, thyme and salt and simmer until thick and gravy-like, {time 8-10 min}. Stir in the peas and spread the filling in the baking dish.
Spoon the mash over the top, spread it to the edges and rough up the surface with a fork. Sprinkle with cheese, if using.
Bake until the filling bubbles at the edges and the top is golden, {time 20-25 min}. Rest for {time 10 min} before serving.

notes: Made with ground lamb instead of beef, it becomes shepherd’s pie.
Assemble ahead and refrigerate for up to 2 days, or freeze for 3 months. Bake from the fridge, adding 15 minutes.
